Author: Rayla Petal
Name: PoseKit
Description: Animation Assistance Plugin, offset your character's pose, save named presets and replay them, auto-discover Penumbra pose mods, and manually resync emote timing with a partner.
Punchline: Offset, save, and replay poses; auto-discover Penumbra animation mods.
Changelog: Fix pick highlighting on the Animations tab (and its "● you"/"● them" badges) lighting up every trigger button under a mod option, not just the specific pose/gesture that was actually picked — an option bound to more than one trigger (e.g. a redirect spanning two emote slots at once) shared one identity across all of them. Each trigger button now has its own identity, so queueing, force-select, and the pairing quick-pick highlight only the exact one chosen.
